column1: # Seconds each spec file under a mirror directory adds to one rspec process (its load plus its
# top-level groups), for bin/verify-changed's mirror-directory time budget (#3289). Written by
# `bundle exec ruby tool/spec_costs.rb [spec dir ...]`, which keeps a row within a factor of two of
# its new value, so a refresh moves only what really changed. A spec missing here is priced at
# bin/verify-changed's spec_cost_default. Measured 2026-11-18 at a load average of about 13 on a
# 12-core host: slower than idle, uniformly enough that the budgets, in the same units, still hold.
